title: Skills: trees and System Arts
summary: 136 skills: the skill tree of every class, the General tree and the System Arts of the battle pass.

blocks.text: Each level gives 1 skill point . You spend points in the skill tree of your class (or the General tree as a Human) to unlock active skills and passives . A skill needs the previous one of its chain at maximum level. Each skill level past the first adds +15% power and −5% cooldown .
blocks.html: Each level gives 1 skill point. You spend points in the skill tree of your class (or the General tree as a Human) to unlock active skills and passives. A skill needs the previous one of its chain at maximum level. Each skill level past the first adds +15% power and −5% cooldown.

blocks.text: Class trees : about 12 skills per class, in 5 tiers (a tier costs as many points per level as its number). Mage schools : the Mage has several schools of magic (fire, ice, lightning, arcane, water, earth, void...). Some of them stay hidden until you place enough school points. General tree : open to every class; full for the Human. System Arts : skills of the battle pass , for every class, no skill points needed. Weapon arts : the skill of a weapon, on key E: see Weapon arts .
blocks.html:
• Class trees: about 12 skills per class, in 5 tiers (a tier costs as many points per level as its number).
  • Mage schools: the Mage has several schools of magic (fire, ice, lightning, arcane, water, earth, void...). Some of them stay hidden until you place enough school points.
  • General tree: open to every class; full for the Human.
  • System Arts: skills of the battle pass, for every class, no skill points needed.
  • Weapon arts: the skill of a weapon, on key E: see Weapon arts.

blocks.text: Each page lists the element, cooldown, mana cost, damage (a percentage of your physical or magic power) and how to unlock it. Cooldowns are base values: see Combat formulas .
